title: stash 栈语义：push / pop / apply 的进出顺序与脏工作区拒绝
expected_output:
=== 初始：干净工作区，app.py = v1 ===
=== 1) stash push -m 'wip: 分页' ===
    stash 深度: 1 ；工作区 app.py 已还原为: v1
=== 2) stash push -m 'wip: 表单'（不带 -u）===
    push 前 status: 已改动=['app.py'] 未跟踪=['debug.log']
    push 后 status: 已改动=[] 未跟踪=['debug.log']
    注意: 未跟踪文件默认**不会**进 stash，需要 git stash -u / --include-untracked

    stash@{0}  wip: 表单   tracked=['app.py'] untracked=[]
    stash@{1}  wip: 分页   tracked=['app.py'] untracked=[]
=== 4) git stash pop（LIFO：先取出最近压入的『表单』）===
    已取出 stash@{0}: wip: 表单
    工作区 app.py = v1 + 表单改动 ；剩余 stash 深度 = 1

    先 git restore app.py 让工作区干净 -> app.py=v1

    最终 stash 深度 = 0

=== 6) 补充场景：git stash push -u（--include-untracked）===
    stash 深度: 1 ；该条记录的未跟踪文件: ['debug.log']
    工作区残留的未跟踪文件: []

实践要点: stash 是**栈**（LIFO）；stash@{0} 永远是最近压入的；
临时切分支用 stash，跨分支搬运半成品更推荐先 commit 到临时分支或用 git worktree
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""`git stash` 是一个 LIFO 栈：`stash@{0}` 永远是最近压入的那条。
push 会把「工作区 + 暂存区」的改动打成快照并还原干净工作树；pop = apply + drop。"""
import zlib


def short(tag):
    return "%07x" % (zlib.crc32(tag.encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFF)


class Repo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.committed = {"app.py": "v1"}
        self.worktree = dict(self.committed)
        self.stash = []          # 末尾 = 栈顶 = stash@{0}
        self.head = short("c1")

    def status(self):
        dirty = sorted(f for f, c in self.worktree.items()
                       if f in self.committed and self.committed[f] != c)
        untracked = sorted(f for f in self.worktree if f not in self.committed)
        return dirty, untracked

    def push(self, msg, include_untracked=False):
        dirty, untracked = self.status()
        if not dirty and not (include_untracked and untracked):
            print("    No local changes to save")
            return None
        entry = {
            "msg": msg,
            "base": self.head,
            "tracked": {f: self.worktree[f] for f in dirty},
            "untracked": {f: self.worktree[f] for f in untracked} if include_untracked else {},
        }
        self.stash.append(entry)
        for f in list(self.worktree):          # 只还原**已跟踪**文件的 committed 版本
            if f in self.committed:
                self.worktree[f] = self.committed[f]
        for f in entry["untracked"]:           # -u 时未跟踪文件被移进 stash
            self.worktree.pop(f, None)
        return entry

    def listing(self):
        return [("stash@{%d}" % i, e["msg"], sorted(e["tracked"]), sorted(e["untracked"]))
                for i, e in enumerate(reversed(self.stash))]

    def _apply(self, entry):
        for f, c in entry["tracked"].items():
            self.worktree[f] = c
        for f, c in entry["untracked"].items():
            self.worktree[f] = c

    def pop(self):
        dirty, _ = self.status()
        if dirty:
            return "error: Your local changes would be overwritten by merge. Please commit or stash them first."
        entry = self.stash.pop()
        self._apply(entry)
        return "已取出 stash@{0}: %s" % entry["msg"]

    def apply(self, index=0):
        dirty, _ = self.status()
        if dirty:
            return "error: 工作区已有改动，apply 会覆盖，请先 commit/stash"
        entry = self.stash[-1 - index]
        self._apply(entry)
        return "已应用 stash@{%d}: %s（栈顶条目仍在）" % (index, entry["msg"])

    def drop(self, index=0):
        e = self.stash.pop(-1 - index)
        return "dropped stash@{%d} (%s)" % (index, e["msg"])


repo = Repo()
print("=== 初始：干净工作区，app.py = %s ===" % repo.worktree["app.py"])

repo.worktree["app.py"] = "v1 + 分页改动"
print("=== 1) stash push -m 'wip: 分页' ===")
repo.push("wip: 分页")
print("    stash 深度: %d ；工作区 app.py 已还原为: %s" % (len(repo.stash), repo.worktree["app.py"]))

repo.worktree["app.py"] = "v1 + 表单改动"
repo.worktree["debug.log"] = "untracked log"
print("=== 2) stash push -m 'wip: 表单'（不带 -u）===")
dirty, untracked = repo.status()
print("    push 前 status: 已改动=%s 未跟踪=%s" % (dirty, untracked))
repo.push("wip: 表单")
dirty, untracked = repo.status()
print("    push 后 status: 已改动=%s 未跟踪=%s" % (dirty, untracked))
print("    注意: 未跟踪文件默认**不会**进 stash，需要 git stash -u / --include-untracked")

print("=== 3) git stash list（栈顶 stash@{0} = 最近一次）===")
for name, msg, tracked, unt in repo.listing():
    print("    %-10s %s   tracked=%s untracked=%s" % (name, msg, tracked, unt))

print("=== 4) git stash pop（LIFO：先取出最近压入的『表单』）===")
print("    " + repo.pop())
print("    工作区 app.py = %s ；剩余 stash 深度 = %d" % (repo.worktree["app.py"], len(repo.stash)))

print("=== 5) 反例：工作区有改动时 pop / apply 均被拒绝 ===")
print("    " + repo.pop())
print("    先 git restore app.py 让工作区干净 -> app.py=%s" % repo.committed["app.py"])
repo.worktree["app.py"] = repo.committed["app.py"]
print("    apply: " + repo.apply())
print("    apply 后 stash 深度仍为 %d（apply 不删条目，需 git stash drop）" % len(repo.stash))
print("    " + repo.drop())
print("    最终 stash 深度 = %d" % len(repo.stash))
print()

print("=== 6) 补充场景：git stash push -u（--include-untracked）===")
repo2 = Repo()
repo2.worktree["app.py"] = "v1 + 调试改动"
repo2.worktree["debug.log"] = "untracked log"
repo2.push("wip: 含调试日志", include_untracked=True)
left = sorted(f for f in repo2.worktree if f not in repo2.committed)
print("    stash 深度: %d ；该条记录的未跟踪文件: %s" % (len(repo2.stash), sorted(repo2.stash[-1]["untracked"])))
print("    工作区残留的未跟踪文件: %s" % left)
print()
print("实践要点: stash 是**栈**（LIFO）；stash@{0} 永远是最近压入的；")
print("临时切分支用 stash，跨分支搬运半成品更推荐先 commit 到临时分支或用 git worktree")
